feature_policy: Existing 17-feature serving encoding; historical climatology uses completed origin month, past-only lag/projection fallback; observed origin anchor in training. No future weather or groundwater in features.

selection.primary: Mean across folds of district-macro MAE on identical observed-origin pairs, with ties broken by mean fold RMSE then candidate name.
selection.final_tree_count: Median of selected candidate fold best_iteration+1, rounded to nearest integer; no January2026 tuning.

final_diagnostic_scope: Previously inspected January2026 labels through actual tiered serving path. A retrospective diagnostic, not an untouched test. Repeated districts/target months are dependent.

promotion_requirements.threshold_units: 0.02 is a relative MAE reduction of 2%; 0.10 is a relative MAE increase of 10%, not metres.
promotion_requirements.rule: All requirements must pass. No independent untouched later labels currently exist; keep production unchanged regardless of inspected diagnostic gains.

uncertainty: Old-model calibration cannot be rebound to new weights. Candidate intervals remain unavailable.
limitations: New measurements have source observation dates but historical publication availability is not established.
Observed-origin training does not establish skill for estimated anchors across stale observation gaps.
The original artifact card records realized-weather training; the candidate uses causal serving-weather assumptions, so gains cannot be attributed solely to enrichment.

The old train() twelve-month-embargo holdout is empty once January2025 labels enter fitting. Earlier folds retain that embargo; the final as-of serving replay uses labels learned by each origin and is explicitly retrospective.
Unmonitored districts retain the existing regional reference; no local skill is inferred from pooled fitting.
